description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing 'Charges' within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting charges, with appropriate security, serialization, and documentation annotations.

classes.name: ChargesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource for managing Charges, including endpoints for CRUD operations and templates, with security, serialization, and documentation annotations.

methods.name: retrieveAllCharges
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all defined charges.

methods.name: retrieveCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific charge by its ID, optionally including a template.

methods.name: retrieveNewChargeDetails
methods.description: Provides a template for creating a new charge with default values and lists.

methods.name: createCharge
methods.description: Creates a new charge based on the provided ChargeRequest.

methods.name: updateCharge
methods.description: Updates an existing charge identified by chargeId with new details.

methods.name: deleteCharge
methods.description: Deletes a charge identified by chargeId.
